overview: A subscription-based women's fitness and nutrition platform delivering personalized workout and meal plan templates tailored to each user's body metrics, fitness goals, and menstrual cycle phase. Features onboarding, cycle tracking, a daily dashboard, progress logging, and Stripe-powered subscription management.
features: Guided onboarding collecting age, weight, height, fitness level, goals, and dietary preferences
Menstrual cycle tracking with auto phase calculation from start date and cycle length
Daily dashboard with cycle phase display, workout templates, and meal plan templates
Water intake tracking and workout/meal completion logging
Profile editing with instant plan template refresh
Subscription management with 7-day free trial and Stripe-powered weekly, monthly, and premium tiers
Responsive mobile-first design with soft, female-centric color palette
